label: Aktiesparekonto (ASK)
Danmark 2026: årlig lagerskatt 17 %. Neg: Denmark 2026: annual mark-to-market tax is 17%. Negative tax is a separate credit, not a loss of value or a salary deduction. The credit expires on closure. The DKK 174,200 deposit limit depends on market value on December 31 of the previous year and net deposits this year; appreciation above the limit need not be sold.
Marknadsvärde den 31 december föregående: Market value on December 31 of the previous year
Obetald kontoskatt från föregående år: Unpaid account tax from the previous year
Ange föregående års kontoskatt som ännu: Enter the previous year’s account tax not yet deducted from the Danish ASK. It is paid at the next February payment or closure and is separate from the negative tax credit.
Ange marknadsvärdet den 31 december före: Enter the market value on December 31 of the previous year (0 for a new account).
Ange kontots marknadsvärde den 1 januari: Enter the account’s market value on January 1 of the forecast’s first year.
